name: Hopeful Night
source:
A boy frustrated with life and hoping to end it finds an unexpected inspiration and some choices.
You play as the boy and his fate is all in your hands.
Will he live to find a better world?
Or will he die anyway?
A short visual novel with three endings and three choices.

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=26487]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
一个对生活感到沮丧并希望结束它的男孩发现了意想不到的灵感和一些选择。
你扮演男孩，他的命运完全掌握在你的手中。
他会活着去寻找一个更美好的世界吗？
或者他无论如何都会死？
一部简短的视觉小说，具有三个结局和三个选择。

[来自[url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=26487]Lemma Soft论坛[/url]]
